data.one_liner: A set of customizable loading animations for Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use loading animations such as flipping, rotating, bouncing grid, and line animations with circle and square variations. Each animation is customizable with parameters like colors, sizes, and durations.
use_when: You need pre-built loading or progress indicators in your Flutter application.
You want simple customization of loading animations using named constructors.
avoid_when: You require complex, vector-based custom animations like Lottie or Rive.
You only need standard Material or Cupertino progress indicators provided by Flutter core.
strengths: Easy to use with ready-to-go named constructors.
Highly customizable with colors, sizes, and durations.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific predefined set of loading animations.
Not documented beyond the basic set of geometric loader styles.
